name: Nag
author: Jankees van Woezik
description: Disposable alarms from one text field: "15:15 pick up the kids", and the bar counts down to it.

barWidget.description: Disposable alarms from one text field: "15:15 pick up the kids", and the bar counts down to it.

schema.label: Hide when idle
schema.description: With no alarm set, show the widget only while the pointer is on the bar, like Omarchy's indicators.

schema.label: Icon
schema.description: A glyph for the bar and the notifications, such as Omarchy's reminder bell 󰢌. Empty keeps the timer.

schema.label: Play a sound
schema.description: Off, alarms ring silently, in the bar and the notification.

schema.label: Sound
schema.description: A file pw-play can read, usually one dropped in ~/.local/share/nag/sounds, which the settings view lists. Empty plays the freedesktop alarm.
